title: Defective, no warranty (warranty only applies if purchased from an authorized Steelcase dealer)
text:
Defective, no warranty (warranty only applies if purchased from an authorized Steelcase dealer). I bought one of these in the Criterion Plus configuration. Unfortunately, the chair had several defects, including an incorrectly located seat, which meant the seatback was not perpendicular to the centerline of the seat, but rotated a few degrees off to the right. The net result is the seatback did not sit flat against my back and supported only the left side of my back, not the right. Obviously, this was not cool, and it caused a great deal of back pain after using it for a while. Once I realized what was going on (took about a month), I stopped using the chair.

I contacted Steelcase re: the "Lifetime" warranty on the chair, but was informed I had not purchased it from an authorized Steelcase dealer, which meant the warranty would NOT be honored. I was 100% out of luck. That's a LOT of money to throw away.

So, caveat emptor (let the buyer beware): before you buy one of these (or ANY Steelcase chair), you may wish to check with Steelcase first to see if the seller you are about to purchase from (there may be several seller choices) is an authorized Steelcase dealer. If not, your warranty will likely be worthless. It should also be noted this was not the only defect in this chair, but it was the most problematic. It did not matter because I was out of luck in any event: I had no warranty whatsoever.
